title: Direct mixed-groundwater merit-oracle diagnosis after G10 safeguard exhaustion
question: Did G10 P4 exhaust because the frozen broad affine GW_MIXED q_gw(H) approximation is not accurate enough in the near-zero-flux coupled neighborhood, or does the direct SWAP-MODFLOW residual itself fail to decrease along the same backtracking line?

direct_qgw_inversion.method: Fresh constant-flux MODFLOW solve at each bisection point; exploit monotone H(q). Returned imposed q is the direct q_gw at the target H within the frozen head tolerance.

direct_coupled_root.method: On the frozen local flux ladder evaluate F(q)=q_swap(H_gw(q))-q using real-SWAP trial->discard. Select the first adjacent sign-changing status-0 pair in ascending q and bisect in q; do not invent a bracket outside the ladder.

evaluate: real-SWAP q_swap at h_k from immutable origin

diagnostic_outputs: broad affine fit reproduced from its frozen probes
local fixed-ladder H(q) points and local affine fits over predefined nested probe subsets
direct q_gw at the three frozen G10 heads
direct coupled root in q-space if a frozen-ladder bracket exists
broad-affine versus direct residual/merit along all 13 frozen P4 backtracking heads
interpretation_rules: G10 remains falsified regardless of G10A outcome.
If broad-affine and direct merit orderings differ, classify the G10 merit oracle as insufficient at the requested convergence scale; do not retroactively pass P4.
If direct merit also has no non-increasing contracted step, retain a genuine P4/globalization failure even after removing the affine-oracle approximation.
Do not relax the G10 1e-15 residual tolerance or 12-contraction budget.
Do not mutate production coupling or production HCOF/RHS.
